steps.what: List stored outreach and fundraising dates
Perform community outreach activities for the sport
Meet media representatives at fundraising events
Sign the appearance note
File the signed appearance note
outputs: filed copy of signed appearance note v1

tasks.design: A job in {CALENDAR} lists stored outreach and fundraising dates. The coach performs the community outreach and meets media representatives at the events. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not publish a statement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Appearances were accepted without a stored date.
tasks.enabler_now: Event date, event type, and sport name are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Showing up stays with the coach.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides what is said in public.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week at the event, not on listing dates.

reach.task: Hear only what the coach says in person

evidence.claim: The executive digest says casting, game strategy, and judging artistry stay with people.

assumptions: Event date, event type, and sport name are stored on the event record. The event record produces them. A blank event date is not an appearance. Filing the note does not publish it.
Native configuration of the event record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach performing community outreach activities for the sport.

incremental.description: Refresh event date, event type, and sport name when the event layout changes, and drop a note the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many event dates are blank. The high end assumes event date, event type, and sport name are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.enabler_now: Session date and program name are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Directing the program stays with the coach.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides the load for the day.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week directing the program, not on listing slots.

reach.task: Train only on the plan the coach signed

tasks.short: Recruit in person and sign the letter.

steps.what: List stored prospect fields with no rank
Identify potential athletes and write recruitment letters
Handle arranging a meeting with the recruits
Discuss offering incentives and athletic scholarships
Sign the recruitment letter
Send only the signed recruitment letter
outputs: filed copy of signed recruitment letter v1

tasks.design: A job in {CRM} lists stored prospect fields and writes no rank. The coach identifies potential athletes, writes the recruitment letters, meets the recruits, and decides any incentives or athletic scholarships. A later job in {EMAIL} sends only the signed letter. It does not grant a scholarship by a rule.
tasks.previous_blocker: Letters went out before the offer was decided.
tasks.enabler_now: Prospect identifier and letter text are already stored once the coach writes them.
tasks.still_hard: The meeting and the offer stay with the coach.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides whether to offer a scholarship.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week with recruits, not on listing fields.

reach.task: Receive only the letter the coach signed

evidence.claim: Digest [S11] says a system that filters or evaluates candidates, including for self-employment, is high-risk. This design does not filter or rank candidates.
Digest [S12] says those duties apply from 2 December 2027.
The executive digest says ranking players to sign fits that high-risk reading. This design does not rank players.

assumptions: Prospect identifier and open fields are stored on the prospect record. The prospect record produces them. A blank field is not filled by a guess. A scholarship is granted only in the text the coach signed, never by a rule.
Native configuration of the prospect record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
The send is that signed letter and no other text.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach identifying potential athletes and writing recruitment letters.

incremental.description: Refresh prospect identifier when the prospect layout changes, and drop a letter the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many prospect fields are blank. The high end assumes prospect identifier and the coach's letter text are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The coach spends the week on the field, with the athletes, and on the signed note. A stored list, an unnamed slot, and filing that signature can move. The coach still runs the session, chooses the people, and signs the note.
reach: An athlete trains only on the session the coach signed.
A parent sees only the note the coach signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a schedule that names a player the coach did not assign.
Reject a scouting claim that does not restate a stored note.
Reject a letter or an order the coach has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed schedule or report can be filed the same day, and the coach still owns the field.
